$comment: Canonical task-type -> phase/command map. The router (CLAUDE.md ROUTING + skills/skill-router) picks from this; tools/render-recipes.py renders the tables there (`short` in CLAUDE.md, `flow` in skill-router) (run it after editing, tests/recipes.test.sh checks they match). The learning watcher infers which recipe a session followed from `infer_from` and proposes changes in recipes/CHANGES.md.
selection: Walk `recipes` top to bottom and take the FIRST whose `when` fits the request; the order runs from most specific to the full pipeline.
If an `escalate` trigger is already true, take its target instead.
Announce one line before any work: `Recipe: <id> — <flow>`, and log {"event":"recipe.selected","recipe":"<id>","reason":"..."} to .claude/agent-events.jsonl.
If an escalation trigger appears mid-task, stop, announce `Recipe: <new> (escalated from <old>: <reason>)` and continue in the new flow from the matching phase.
Ambiguous between two recipes: ask ONE question naming both. Never default to the full pipeline just because it is the safest-looking choice.

recipes.title: Hotfix
recipes.when: Production is down or a critical regression is live right now.
flow: follow up with `bug-fix` for the class fix
recipes.done_when: Production smoke green on live URLs; a `bug-fix` follow-up is recorded.

recipes.title: Trivial change
recipes.when: Diff fits one sentence, touches at most 2 files, and has no schema/env/auth/payment/URL-topology surface.
escalate: a third file or any guarded surface appears -> enhancement

recipes.title: Docs sync
recipes.when: Docs, living docs, handoff or README updates with no change to code behaviour.
flow: /dev-pipeline:review only if the docs define a contract (API, env, URL, schema)
escalate: the doc change implies a contract change -> contract-change
recipes.done_when: Docs match the code they describe; links resolve.

recipes.title: Review only
recipes.when: Review, audit or second opinion on a diff, branch or PR; no fixing asked for.
flow: stop: fixes go through `bug-fix` or `pr-feedback` on the user's yes
recipes.skips: all writing phases; makes no edits
escalate: the user asks to fix what was found -> bug-fix or pr-feedback
recipes.done_when: Findings reported (or HEAD blessed when the diff is clean).

recipes.title: Test only
recipes.when: Add or repair tests, or raise coverage, without changing behaviour.
escalate: a new test exposes a real bug -> bug-fix (never rewrite the expectation, Rule 19)
recipes.done_when: New tests fail when the behaviour they guard is broken (checked once by mutation or revert) and pass now.

recipes.title: UI design round
recipes.when: The ask is visual/UX: designs, options, mockups, a redesign, or a partner's UI change request. No building yet.
flow: design skill for the stack: ui-ux-pro-max (spec) / huashu-design (HTML prototype, 3 directions) / frontend-design

write docs/<slug>/ui-design.md (+ prototype) covering EVERY platform the project ships; for iOS include each state at the largest accessibility Dynamic Type size, VoiceOver labels and Reduce Motion behaviour
recipes.short: design-checker → design skill → ui-design.md for every platform → user picks → stop
escalate: the user says build it -> enhancement (one surface) or feature (new flow)
recipes.done_when: The user picked a direction and ui-design.md is on disk.

recipes.title: Digest a new PRD
recipes.when: A PRD, brief or spec arrives for an EXISTING project and must become a plan. No code yet.
recipes.short: prd-parser → spec-elicitor gaps → `/plan` (1-6) → stop at G4
escalate: the PRD is for a NEW project -> new-project
recipes.done_when: SPEC.md and the MIU breakdown are approved at G4; open questions listed.

recipes.title: New project
recipes.when: Start a brand-new project from a PRD or description.
recipes.done_when: Scaffold builds and its first test passes.

recipes.title: Cross-lane contract change
recipes.when: An API/OpenAPI/DTO/shared-fixture change that another lane (backend, web, iOS, admin) consumes.
flow: /dev-pipeline:plan scoped to the contract + every consumer
change the producer AND regenerate every consumer's types in the same PR
message each consuming lane's session with the contract diff (never ask the user to relay)
recipes.short: `/plan` (contract + consumers) → producer + all consumer types in one PR → `/verify-contract` → `/verify-blast-radius` → `/review` → `/deliver` → tell each lane
recipes.skips: UI design (unless a consumer's UI changes), HLD diagrams
escalate: a new product capability sits behind the contract -> feature
recipes.done_when: Producer and every consumer build against the new contract; each consuming lane has been told.

recipes.title: Provider setup (owner steps)
recipes.when: Set up or change a third-party provider account (payments, email, DNS, hosting, app store, OAuth) where some steps only the owner can do in a dashboard.
flow: stack-setup skill: check what already exists and do every step an API or CLI allows yourself
open the provider's REAL dashboard in the browser and read each page before writing a step; never guess page, menu or field names
write the owner's steps click by click: every field, toggle, dropdown value, pop-up and confirmation, including dialogs that ask what a key is for and per-row permission columns
one list per environment (sandbox/test and live never interleaved), each self-contained
say up front which settings the provider keeps locked and what unlocks them (account profile, live activation) before any step depends on them
secrets only through the secure-key-handoff skill; never print a key in chat or logs, rotate any that leaked
verify with stack-setup's check (or the provider's API) and record what exists
recipes.short: stack-setup → read the real dashboard → click-by-click owner steps, one list per environment → locks up front → secure-key-handoff → verify
recipes.skips: spec, design, architecture, MIUs (code the setup needs runs as its own recipe)
escalate: the setup needs new code or env vars -> enhancement
it changes a contract other lanes consume -> contract-change
recipes.done_when: Every API/CLI step is done by the agent; the owner's remaining steps are click by click, one list per environment, checked against the live dashboard; stack-setup check is green; no secret appeared in chat.

learned.note: A live payment-provider setup: steps written from docs missed a key-creation dialog's 'how will you use this key' choice and a per-row Connect permission column, mixed sandbox and live, and found only at the end that OAuth and the live client ID stay locked until the platform profile and live activation are done. Two sandbox secrets were printed in chat and had to be rotated.
learned.evidence: 1 session plus the owner's own feedback

recipes.title: Bug fix
recipes.when: A reported bug, error message or wrong behaviour with a findable cause.
escalate: intermittent, multi-module or unclear root cause -> feature (BUG_FIX_COMPLEX runs /dev-pipeline:pipeline)
recipes.done_when: Regression test went red then green; siblings of the root cause checked (Rule 11).

recipes.title: Address PR feedback
recipes.when: Review comments on an open PR need answering or fixing.
escalate: a comment asks for new behaviour -> enhancement
recipes.done_when: Every comment fixed or answered with evidence; HEAD blessed.

recipes.title: Small enhancement
recipes.when: Improve an existing feature inside one module with no schema/auth/payment/env/URL surface.
recipes.skips: HLD/LLD diagrams, cloud-design-patterns audit, separate G1-G3 (one Scope-Lock instead)
escalate: touches schema, auth, payments, env vars or URL topology -> feature
needs a new screen or flow -> ui-design-round first, then feature
recipes.done_when: Change validated, reviewed and delivered; affected UI checked on every platform it ships to (iOS: largest accessibility text size, VoiceOver, Reduce Motion, in the simulator).

recipes.title: Refactor proposal
recipes.when: Clean up, restructure or simplify working code.
recipes.done_when: Proposal written; the user accepted or declined by ID.

recipes.title: Performance
recipes.when: Something is slow, heavy or janky.
recipes.skips: spec unless a budget must be decided

recipes.title: Deliver
recipes.when: Ship it: commit, push, open or merge a PR, deploy.
recipes.done_when: Merged and verified on production URLs.

recipes.title: Build a feature
recipes.when: New capability, screen, endpoint or flow; or anything touching schema, auth, payments, env vars or URL topology; or a complex/intermittent bug.
recipes.done_when: PR merged, production verified (Rules 17, 20), traceability (8.6) green; iOS surfaces pass engineering-craft checklists/ios-swiftui-surface.md.
